Circuit Breaker and Switch Lockouts guide

What Is Circuit Breaker Lockout Equipment?

Critical pointSwitch the breaker off first, then fit the padlock and tag; then always confirm with a measuring instrument that the line is truly de-energized.

Circuit breaker lockout equipment is a LOTO device that physically prevents the circuit breaker in a panel from being switched on or off by someone else during maintenance. In the field it is also searched for as a breaker lock, fuse lock or panel fuse lock. After the breaker is set to the OFF position, the device is fitted over the toggle, and a safety padlock and warning tag are attached to it.

A common scenario in electrical work accidents is the line being worked on being re-energized by someone unaware. The lock eliminates this possibility mechanically, while the tag tells those nearby why and by whom the panel was locked.

Because the toggle width and body construction of each breaker vary by brand and type, a single model does not fit every panel. That is why we offer more than 20 different lockout models together, for miniature circuit breakers (MCB), moulded case breakers and large-type circuit breakers.

Types of Circuit Breaker Lockout Equipment

POS, PIS, TBLO and POW type MCB lockouts

Developed for miniature breakers inside panels, these types differ by toggle direction and how they fit into the holes on the breaker.

BD-D01BD-D02BD-D03

Universal MCB lockouts

Their adjustable design adapts to different brands and toggle widths, offering a single solution for mixed-brand panels.

BD-D05-1-REDBD-D05-3BD-D05-5-RED

Clamp-on shackle padlocks

Models that wrap around the toggle and are tightened with a screw for a firm grip on moulded case circuit breakers and breakers with wide toggles.

BD-D11NBD-D12XBD-D13X

Snap-on lockouts

Fits and comes off in seconds without tools; saves time on panels where maintenance is frequent.

Tight-fit and large-grip lockouts

Large-body models that grip the handle firmly on high-current circuit breakers with wide handles.

MCB lockouts with tag

Combines lockout and tagout in a single body; also reduces the need to hang a separate tag in tight panels.

Buying guide

How to Choose the Right Circuit Breaker Lockout Equipment?

Check these criteria before ordering. If you are unsure, send a photo and we will choose together.

Ask an expert
  • Breaker type: Determine whether the device to be locked is an MCB, a moulded case circuit breaker or a large circuit breaker; each group works with a different family of locks.
  • Toggle dimensions: Measure the width and thickness of the toggle; if the dimensions are uncertain, prefer adjustable universal models.
  • Fitting type: Some MCB locks seat with pins in the holes below or above the toggle, so check the hole layout on the breaker body.
  • Mounting method: Choose tool-free snap-on models for fast, frequent use, and screw-type clamp-on models where a tight, permanent hold is required.
  • Padlock compatibility: Make sure the lockout hole on the device matches the shackle diameter of the safety padlock you use.
  • Set requirement: For panels containing different types of breakers, consider electrical LOTO sets that include several locks together.
Applications

Where Is Circuit Breaker Lockout Equipment Used?

Distribution panels

In building and facility panels, the energy of each line is isolated and locked out separately.

Machine control cabinets

Before maintenance of production machines, main and auxiliary switches are fixed in the off position.

MCC and automation panels

In motor control centres, many circuit breakers are locked out at the same time.

Energy and infrastructure facilities

Circuit breakers are safely kept disabled during transformer, generator and power plant maintenance.

Frequently asked questions

About Circuit Breaker and Switch Lockouts

If you could not find the answer you are looking for, message us on WhatsApp and we will determine the right model together.

Ask on WhatsApp
Which circuit breaker lockout fits my panel?
First determine the circuit breaker type (MCB, moulded case, large circuit breaker) and trigger width. Universal models suit mixed-brand panels and clamp-on models suit moulded case circuit breakers; if you send front and side photos of the breaker via WhatsApp, we can choose the right model together.
How much does circuit breaker lockout equipment cost?
Prices vary by model, size and order quantity. For a current quote, stock and delivery information, you can message the product code and quantity to our WhatsApp line or call us by phone.
What do POS, PIS, TBLO and POW mean?
These names are type designations describing how miniature circuit breaker lockouts attach to the breaker. They differ by the position of the toggle and the holes on the breaker; the choice is made according to the construction of the breaker in your panel.
Are tools needed for installation?
Snap-on and many MCB lockouts fit without tools. Clamp-on models are secured with a small screw so they grip the toggle firmly.
Can more than one person attach a lock to the same circuit breaker?
Yes. A hasp is fitted to the hole of the breaker lockout and each worker adds their own padlock to it. The breaker cannot be opened until the last lock is removed.
Is it compatible with brands such as ABB and Schneider?
Universal and adjustable models fit most breakers of common brands. To be sure, you can send us the model information or a photo of your breaker.
Is an additional check needed after a circuit breaker lockout is applied?
Yes. After lockout and tagout, it must be verified with a suitable measuring instrument that the line is truly de-energized, and work should begin only after that.

Circuit Breaker Lockout Equipment Prices and Models

Circuit breaker lockout equipment is the most fundamental part of the electrical side of LOTO programs. From miniature circuit breaker lockouts to moulded case circuit breaker lockouts, and from snap-on models to large clamp-style devices, you can find a wide range of models in a single category.

The right model depends on the breaker type, toggle size and mounting preference. Universal lockouts for mixed-brand panels, tool-free snap-on models for frequently serviced points and screw-clamp lockouts for moulded case breakers offer practical solutions. Remember to use each device together with a safety padlock and a warning tag.

Because circuit breaker lockout prices vary by model and quantity, we prepare a quote specific to your needs. Simply send the product code, the quantity or a photo of your breaker via WhatsApp or phone.
